entities.name: Emilien
entities.voice: quick, defends himself before he is accused; a boy's face; right palm bandaged

entities.name: Detective Kovac
entities.voice: forty-five, grey, coughs; burnt out; speaks like a man who already regrets opening his mouth

entities.name: Eduard Riff
entities.voice: measured, answers precisely, never raises his voice; under pressure only shorter

entities.name: Madelaine Zheber
entities.voice: grief worn as a shape; never weeps before strangers; calls Riff 'an old friend of the family'

entities.name: Madelaine's Neighbours
entities.voice: two women who miss nothing on the lane and enjoy being asked

entities.name: Private Antonio Gallierez
entities.voice: twenty-two with a face ten years older; speaks calmly; his left arm does not work

entities.name: Gallierez's Squadmates
entities.voice: rough, loyal, they finish each other's sentences

entities.name: Gabriel Sanchez
entities.voice: big and shaggy; loud and drunk by evening, sober and slow by morning

entities.name: Doctor Arens
entities.voice: slow, hands scarred; no love for command, great love for detail

entities.name: Private Kempe
entities.voice: young, honest, afraid of blame; by the book, but human if you let him be

entities.name: Falco the Barman
entities.voice: few words, watchful, does not gossip without reason

entities.name: Old Pierre
entities.voice: has not slept since the war; smokes on the step from four in the morning; answers in one word

entities.name: Mazur the Trader
entities.voice: businesslike, no interest in politics, keeps his ledger straight

entities.name: A Leather Pouch and a Syringe
Miguel Sanchez's Diary
entities.voice: Miguel's hand: 'they gave it again', 'my head hums', 'as if we were cattle'

entities.name: Gallierez's Medical Card
entities.voice: Arens's hand; 'toxicology not performed — order of a senior officer'

entities.name: The Checkpoint Log
entities.voice: oilcloth cover, pencil; 'Capt. Zheber — 23:05', 'noise — HQ' in the night column

facts.key: Captain Zheber was found dead in his own office at 07:00
A leather pouch of stimulant powder and a syringe sit in Zheber's office
Pinpoint haemorrhages in the eyes and mouth — the mark of asphyxia
Zheber never took the drug himself; his forearms are clean
Fibres of heavy blue cloth in the corpse's mouth and nose
A triangle is torn from the office curtain, a dark stain beside it
Shards of a crested tumbler lie behind the office cabinet
Zheber passed the checkpoint back onto the base at 23:05
The sentry heard an odd noise from headquarters that night — breaking glass
Emilien entered the base three times by daylight on the Sanchez case
Mazur saw Emilien on the fort road at dawn, one sleeve bloodied
Falco heard from the trader Mazur that he had seen a policeman on the road
Pierre saw Emilien walk into Kalderes around five in the morning
Emilien came in from the fort road at dawn, holding his right hand
Pale road clay on Emilien's boots; there is no such clay in Kalderes
Emilien's right palm is bandaged; he says he broke a glass at home
The glass from Emilien's boot matches the break of the shards in the office
facts.summation_clause: Start with your boot: the glass ground into the heel matches the break of the shards on that office floor, edge for edge.

facts.key: Miguel Sanchez's diary lies in the bottom drawer of Emilien's desk
facts.summation_clause: And the reason is in your own bottom drawer: Sanchez's diary, which Zheber had begun to read.

facts.key: Riff spent the murder night with Madelaine Zheber — a long, hidden affair
Riff calls Madelaine by her first name, and far too warmly
The neighbours saw Riff leaving Madelaine's house at night, that night included
Gabriel drank at Falco's until closing and slept on the bench
Gabriel has never passed the checkpoint, and the sentry would not pass him
Sober, Gabriel shows he knows nothing of the drugging of the ranks
Gallierez's left hand will not close; he cannot tie a lace with it
The card records a fractured arm, a contracture, and toxicology refused by order
The squad confirms the hand has been dead a month; they carry his kit for him
Kovac closed the Sanchez case under pressure, not conviction
Private Miguel Sanchez's death was filed as an overdose
Zheber was strangled with his own curtain; the drug was planted after death
facts.summation_clause: He was strangled with his own curtain cord, and the drug went into him afterwards, by a hand that wanted a different story told.

facts.key: The killing falls between 23:30 and 03:00 on the night of the 14th
facts.summation_clause: It happened between half past eleven and three, on the night of the fourteenth — the window the infirmary clock leaves open and no alibi of yours covers.

facts.key: Zheber dosed his men with combat stimulants for parade results; Sanchez died of it

scene_props.name: Filing cabinets
scene_props.text: Four cabinets stand shoulder to shoulder, leaving a gap you turn sideways for.

scene_props.name: Coat rack
scene_props.text: A heavy rack by the door, three oilskins hanging wet on it.

scene_props.name: Office typewriter
scene_props.text: A squat machine with the letter e worn pale on its key.

scene_props.name: Iron stove
scene_props.text: The stove ticks and pops as it cools, loud in the quiet room.

scene_props.name: Market awnings
scene_props.text: Canvas awnings run the length of the square, and the crowd runs with them.

scene_props.name: The town well
scene_props.text: A low stone rim, chest high, with a bucket left on the coping.

scene_props.name: Church steps
scene_props.text: Six worn steps that put you a head above everyone in the square.

scene_props.name: Card table
scene_props.text: Four men at cards, and a fifth watching over their shoulders.

scene_props.name: Back stairs
scene_props.text: Stairs to the upper floor, the landing overlooking the whole room.

scene_props.name: Crate of empties
scene_props.text: A crate of bottles stacked against the wall, waiting for the cart.

scene_props.name: Iron bedstead
scene_props.text: A narrow iron bed, blankets folded square as if for inspection.

scene_props.name: Washstand
scene_props.text: A basin, a razor, a strop hanging from a nail beside it.

scene_props.name: Shuttered window
scene_props.text: The shutters are closed and latched; the room keeps the dusk in.

scene_props.name: Hall mirror
scene_props.text: A tall mirror in the hall, spotted with age along one edge.

scene_props.name: Umbrella stand
scene_props.text: A brass stand holding two umbrellas and a walking cane.

scene_props.name: Stair landing
scene_props.text: The landing looks down on the front door and everyone who uses it.

scene_props.name: Flour sacks
scene_props.text: Sacks stacked waist high, the topmost split and leaking white.

scene_props.name: Bread oven
scene_props.text: The oven roars behind its iron door; talk here is half shouting.

scene_props.name: Delivery hatch
scene_props.text: A hatch to the alley, wide enough for a tray and not much else.

scene_props.name: Milestone
scene_props.text: A squat stone marker, the numeral on it half eaten by lichen.

scene_props.name: Roadside ditch
scene_props.text: The ditch runs deep and close beside the road, brimming after rain.

scene_props.name: Stand of pines
scene_props.text: Pines crowd the verge and keep the road in shadow even at noon.

scene_props.name: Votive rack
scene_props.text: Most of the candles have guttered; the rack holds more wax than light.

scene_props.name: Bell rope
scene_props.text: The rope hangs to knee height, knotted at the end and slightly swinging.

scene_props.name: Gallery stair
scene_props.text: A stair to the gallery, from which the whole nave is visible.

scene_props.name: Sandbag revetment
scene_props.text: Sandbags piled to chest height, the lower course rotted through.

scene_props.name: Striped barrier
scene_props.text: A painted pole across the road; foot traffic squeezes past one at a time.

scene_props.name: Sentry box
scene_props.text: A wooden box barely wide enough for one man and his rifle.

scene_props.name: Watchtower ladder
scene_props.text: A ladder to the platform, two rungs replaced with fresh timber.

scene_props.name: Flagstaff
scene_props.text: The staff has a maintenance step cleated to it, chest high off the gravel.

scene_props.name: Stacked drums
scene_props.text: Empty oil drums stacked three deep at the edge of the ground.

scene_props.name: Gravel drill lane
scene_props.text: Gravel crunches under everything; nobody crosses this yard quietly.

scene_props.name: Map table
scene_props.text: A table under a pinned map, dividers and a rule laid across it.

scene_props.name: Regimental colours
scene_props.text: The colours hang on a standing pole beside the inner door.

scene_props.name: Balcony door
scene_props.text: A door to the balcony above the parade ground, its bolt drawn back.

scene_props.name: Wall safe
scene_props.text: A squat safe under the window, its dial worn smooth at the numerals.

scene_props.name: Desk lamp
scene_props.text: The lamp throws a small circle and leaves the corners entirely dark.

scene_props.name: Service door
scene_props.text: A servant's door behind the desk, narrow enough to catch a shoulder.

scene_props.name: Rows of bunks
scene_props.text: Bunks in two rows with an aisle a rifle's length wide between them.

scene_props.name: Footlockers
scene_props.text: Lockers along the wall, one of them standing open and half emptied.

scene_props.name: Barracks stove
scene_props.text: The stove is banked and hissing; the pipe rattles whenever the wind turns.

scene_props.name: Screens on castors
scene_props.text: Folding screens on castors, pushed together at the end of the ward.

scene_props.name: Instrument tray
scene_props.text: A tray of instruments laid out on cloth, boiled and not yet used.

scene_props.name: Linen press
scene_props.text: A press wedged between two beds; the door opens only halfway.

scene_props.name: Lamp above the table
scene_props.text: The lamp above the table is out, and the ward keeps its far end in shadow.

aftermath: Emilien was taken to Kalderes under escort before the garrison woke. The Zheber house was closed within the month, and the road to Forte Merlo kept its checkpoint but lost its captain. Sanchez's diary went into evidence and was never returned to his family.
cold_case_text: The garrison buried Zheber with honours and the file went to Kalderes marked accidental. Emilien served out his posting and transferred east. The diary stayed in the bottom drawer of a desk that nobody had reason to open again.

flavour.ask_about: You ask it sideways, as if it hardly mattered, and watch not the words but the way they are said.
flavour.clock.cover_up.filled: A staff car comes down from the district in the afternoon. By evening the pouch and the syringe are 'not among the effects', and the word going round headquarters is a private weakness, one officer, regrettable, closed.
flavour.clock.flight.filled: Emilien's footlocker is open and half empty, and his coat is gone from the nail. He has not run yet. He has decided to.
flavour.compare.night_window: He went in at five past eleven and he was found at seven. The sentry's glass breaks in between; Emilien is on the road at first light. The night closes to a few hours with two men inside it.
flavour.compare.nothing: You hold the two facts side by side for a while. They are both true and they have nothing to say to each other.
flavour.compare.riff_alibi: The name he used and the nights the neighbours counted are the same thing said twice. Riff was not in headquarters that night. He was in the dead man's house, and the reason he will not say so is not murder.
flavour.compare.shards_match: You set the glass from the boot against the pieces from behind the cabinet. The break runs on across both, tooth into tooth, the crest continuing where it should. There was one tumbler, and it broke in that office, and part of it walked out in a policeman's boot.
flavour.cross_reference.e_body_zheber.f_strangle: Put together, the body stops arguing. He was taken from behind with the curtain, and the drug went into a man who was already past objecting to it — a death dressed, afterwards, in the death of Miguel Sanchez.
flavour.cross_reference.e_kpp_log.f_emilien_prev: Three daylight entries in the past month, the same assistant's card number each time, the last of them eight days before the killing.
flavour.cross_reference.e_mazur.f_emilien_at_daw: Set against the hour of the cart and the distance from the fort, Mazur's sighting puts Emilien on that road while the base was still asleep.
flavour.cross_reference.e_pierre.f_emilien_at_da: The baker's hour and the trader's hour close on each other: one man, one road, coming down from the fort before the town was up.
flavour.emote: You do it without a word, and the silence reads too — to anyone who can read it.
flavour.examine.e_body_zheber: The captain has no more to say to you today.
flavour.examine.e_body_zheber.f_fibers_in_mouth: Deep in the mouth, and further, in the nostrils, there are threads of a heavy blue weave — the kind that hangs in a window and is never washed.
flavour.examine.e_body_zheber.f_petechiae: Under the lids and along the inner lip the small vessels have burst in a fine spray. The face kept its colour, which is worse than if it had not.
flavour.examine.e_boots_emilien: Clay, welt, heel. You have had everything these boots will give you.
flavour.examine.e_boots_emilien.f_emilien_at_daw: The clay is not yet grey through — it was walked on wet, and once, and not many hours before you took it in your hands.
flavour.examine.e_diary_sanchez: You turn the last pages again. Miguel has said everything he was able to say.
flavour.examine.e_diary_sanchez.f_drug_program: The last pages are barely writing. 'They gave it again.' 'My head hums.' 'As if we were cattle, and the cattle win the parade.' The dates run up to four days before he died.
flavour.examine.e_drug_pouch: Leather, glass, powder. It has told you what it has.
flavour.examine.e_drug_pouch.f_drugs_in_office: Soft leather, worn shiny at the mouth, and a glass syringe wrapped in flannel. The powder inside is army issue and there is a great deal more of it than one man needs.
flavour.examine.e_gallierez: He waits while you look at him, which is its own kind of answer, and there is nothing new in it.
flavour.examine.e_gallierez.f_gallierez_hand: He holds the hand out flat because he cannot make it do anything else. The fingers will not close on yours. He cannot tie his own lace and does not pretend otherwise.
flavour.examine.e_kpp_log: Pencil, oilcloth, a careful hand. You have read every line that matters.
flavour.examine.e_kpp_log.f_night_noise: Lower in the same column, in the same pencil but pressed harder: 'noise — HQ'. No time against it, and no note of who was sent to look.
flavour.examine.e_kpp_log.f_zheber_returned_2305: The night column, in pencil, in a careful hand: 'Capt. Zheber — 23:05.' Nothing after it until the morning relief.
flavour.examine.e_medcard_gallierez: Three weeks of entries and one refused test. You have read it all.
flavour.examine.e_medcard_gallierez.f_gallierez_: Fracture of the left forearm, complication, established contracture. Three weeks of entries in the same slow hand. Then, at the foot of the page: toxicology not performed — order of a senior officer.
flavour.examine.e_portiere: Heavy blue cloth, a torn corner, a stiff dark patch. Nothing further comes out of it.
flavour.examine.e_portiere.f_portiere_torn: The left-hand curtain is short of a triangle at the bottom corner, torn along the weave rather than cut. Beside the tear the cloth has dried stiff and dark.
flavour.examine.e_shards_office: You turn the pieces over again. Glass, crest, clean breaks — all of it already counted.
flavour.examine.e_shards_office.f_office_shards_: Behind the cabinet, out of the sweep of a broom, lie the pieces of a cut-glass tumbler with the regimental crest. Someone collected the obvious ones and missed these.
flavour.look: You look closer, holding your eyes where they would usually slide past. Nothing new opens up, but the picture thickens.
flavour.look.n_bakery: The oven throws light across the step where Pierre sits with his tobacco. Bread is the only clock in this building, and it runs from four in the morning.
flavour.look.n_bar: Falco's is low, warm and smells of spilled anise. The benches along the wall are worn into shallow beds by men who did not make it home.
flavour.look.n_emilien_home: A rented room the width of its bed. A washstand, a nail for a coat, a footlocker. Nothing on the walls — as if the tenant meant to leave at any hour.
flavour.look.n_fort_barracks: Forty bunks, two stoves, wet cloth on every line. The talk drops when you enter and picks up again a half-tone lower.
flavour.look.n_fort_hospital: The infirmary is three beds and a scrubbed table. Arens keeps his instruments in the order of a man who has been shouted at for the last time.
flavour.look.n_fort_hq: Headquarters smells of wet wool and sealing wax. Someone has already begun the paperwork of a death, and the corridor to the captain's door is very quiet.
flavour.look.n_fort_kpp: A striped pole, a lantern, and a boy with a rifle he holds like a shovel. The log book lies on the sill under an oilcloth, open at the night column.
flavour.look.n_fort_yard: The parade ground is beaten flat and running with water. Men cross it fast and without looking up, the way men do where inspections are frequent.
flavour.look.n_kalderes: Kalderes is a street and a half of whitewash going grey, hung between the sea road and the fort road. Everyone here knows which of the two brought the money and which brought the trouble.
flavour.look.n_police_office: Two desks, one lamp, and a stove that has not been lit since spring. Kovac's ashtray is a small grey hill. The junior clerk's desk is tidy in the way of a man who has learned to be looked at.
flavour.look.n_road_to_fort: The road climbs out of the town in pale clay that takes a bootprint like wax and keeps it until the next rain. Tonight the rain is coming in sideways off the water.
flavour.look.n_santa_irene: A market town with a customs house and an inn, one long day's cart from Kalderes. Traders wait out the weather here and talk while they wait.
flavour.look.n_zheber_home: The captain's house keeps its shutters half closed. Inside, everything is arranged for a man who is not coming back, and no one has moved a chair yet.
flavour.look.n_zheber_office: The captain's office has been left as it was found. The lamp is out, the window is unlatched a finger's width, and one curtain hangs badly, as if something heavy had swung on it.
flavour.move_zone.n_bakery: Pierre does not look up. The smell of bread follows you half the street.
flavour.move_zone.n_bar: Falco lifts two fingers as you leave — neither goodbye nor invitation.
flavour.move_zone.n_emilien_home: You pull the door to. The latch does not catch on the first try.
flavour.move_zone.n_fort_barracks: The talk resumes behind you before the door is shut.
flavour.move_zone.n_fort_hospital: Arens returns to his table without waiting for you to go.
flavour.move_zone.n_fort_hq: Your boots are loud in the corridor. Nobody comes out to see who it is.
flavour.move_zone.n_fort_kpp: The pole comes up, the boy salutes a beat too late, and you are past.
flavour.move_zone.n_fort_yard: You cut across the open ground with your collar up.
flavour.move_zone.n_kalderes: You cross the square. Somebody's shutter closes as you pass, unhurried, deliberate.
flavour.move_zone.n_police_office: You take your coat off the nail and step out into the wet.
flavour.move_zone.n_road_to_fort: The clay pulls at your heels the whole way. It would pull at anyone's.
flavour.move_zone.n_santa_irene: You take the cart road back, with the sea on your left the whole way.
flavour.move_zone.n_zheber_home: You leave the house holding its breath behind you.
flavour.move_zone.n_zheber_office: You leave the office as you found it, and pull the door until it clicks.
flavour.persuade.e_kempe.f_night_noise: The boy stops reciting. 'It was glass, sir. Breaking. I thought — a bottle, officers, you know. I did not go and look, and I have not slept right since, if you want the truth of it.'
flavour.question.e_arens.f_petechiae: Arens turns the lamp so you can see. 'The eyes. And under the lip. That is pressure, detective — the heart still pushing and nowhere for it to go. You do not get that from a needle.'
flavour.question.e_arens.f_sanchez_case_closed: 'I opened that boy up and wrote what I was allowed to write. Overdose. It is not a lie. It is only the last third of a sentence.'
flavour.question.e_arens.f_zheber_not_user: 'I looked because you would have asked. Both forearms, both thighs — clean. No scars, no thickening, nothing of the habit. Whatever was in him that night, it was new to him.'
flavour.question.e_emilien.f_emilien_cut_hand: He answers before you finish. 'A glass. At home. Stupid — I was washing it and it went in my hand.' The bandage is clean and very recent, and he keeps the palm turned away.
flavour.question.e_falco.f_falco_heard_mazur: Falco wipes the same glass twice. 'Trader stopped the night here — Mazur. Said he'd seen your policeman out on the fort road, early. Then he went on to Santa Irene, so ask him, not me.'
flavour.question.e_falco.f_gabriel_at_bar_all_ni: 'Gabriel was on that bench from dark to when I put the bar up, and after it too. I stepped over him to sweep. He could not have found the door, let alone the fort.'
flavour.question.e_gabriel.f_gabriel_ignorant_dr: Sober, he is slow and ashamed. You mention what was given to the ranks and he only stares. 'Given? Given what?' Whatever killed his brother, he has been shouting at the wrong shape of it.
flavour.question.e_gallierez.f_drug_program: 'Before every review. A box, a line, the captain at the end of it. You went up the wall like a lizard and you did not feel your hands. Miguel got one more than me. That is the whole difference between us.'
flavour.question.e_gallierez.f_zheber_not_user: Gallierez almost laughs. 'The captain? He handed it out. He stood at the end of the line with the box and he watched us take it. He never took it. He had to be able to write the report after.'
flavour.question.e_kempe.f_emilien_previous_visi: 'The young policeman? Three times, sir, by day, on the Sanchez business. Assistant's card. I passed him myself — he always knew where he was going.'
flavour.question.e_kempe.f_gabriel_no_pass: 'The dead man's brother? He has never been through my gate, sir, and he never will be. He shouts at the pole from the road sometimes. I write that down as well.'
flavour.question.e_kempe.f_zheber_returned_2305: 'The captain came back at five past eleven, sir. I wrote it down because I always write it down. He did not say anything. He never did.'
flavour.question.e_kovac.f_kovac_disillusioned: Kovac coughs into his fist for a while. 'I closed it because I was told what the file would say before I opened it. The boy came to me every day with his papers. Every day I sent him out.'
flavour.question.e_kovac.f_sanchez_case_closed: 'Sanchez. Private, nineteen, found in the barracks. Overdose, signed, filed.' He says it flat, the way a man reads out a debt he means to pay.
flavour.question.e_mazur.f_mazur_saw_emilien: 'Young fellow, police coat, walking down off the fort road when the light was still grey. I remember because his sleeve was wet through dark and he put his hand behind him when the cart came past.'
flavour.question.e_neighbors.f_neighbor_saw_riff: 'The tall officer? Oh, he comes. Not for the captain, mind — the captain's away those nights.' The other one nods along. 'That night as well. Left before the milk.'
flavour.question.e_pierre.f_pierre_saw_emilien: Pierre takes the cigarette out of his mouth. 'Five. Maybe ten past. Came in off that side. Held his hand. Looked at the ground.' He puts the cigarette back.
flavour.question.e_riff.f_drug_program: Riff is silent long enough that you know the answer before he gives it. 'I knew. I wrote a letter I did not send. He would have called it initiative and been promoted for it.'
flavour.question.e_riff.f_riff_slip: Riff speaks of the captain evenly, correctly, for a long time. Then: 'Madelaine will need the pension papers signed.' Not 'the widow'. Not 'Mrs Zheber'. He hears it himself and does not correct it.
flavour.question.e_squadmates.f_gallierez_squadm: 'A month, near enough.' 'We do his straps.' 'He carries with the right and we do the rest.' They say it the way men say a thing they have stopped finding remarkable.
flavour.rest.long: You take a bed and lose the rest of the day to it. The town goes on deciding what happened while you sleep.
flavour.rest.short: You sit on a wall out of the wind for a quarter of an hour and let your hands stop shaking. Nothing heals. Something steadies.
flavour.say: You say it out loud. The words go off into the wet and stay in somebody's memory longer than you would like.
flavour.search.e_boots_emilien.f_boots_mud: Pale clay in the welt and up the side of the heel, still damp in the seam. There is red earth in Kalderes and clay on the fort road, and this is the clay.
flavour.search.e_desk_emilien.f_diary_in_desk: The bottom drawer is locked with the kind of lock that is a suggestion. Under a folded shirt lies a soldier's notebook, and the name inked inside the cover is Miguel Sanchez.
flavour.talk_to: You start a conversation about nothing in particular — the weather, the tide, how anyone lives out here at all. Such talk settles nothing, and afterwards people speak to you differently.
flavour.thank: You thank them, briefly and without flourish. It is noticed: in this town gratitude is heard less often than demands.
flavour.theorize.recorded: You say it aloud to hear how it stands up, and write it in the back of your notebook. Not a charge yet. A shape to keep hold of.
flavour.threaten_verbally: You do not raise your voice and you promise nothing specific. Sometimes that is enough. Sometimes that is exactly where it goes wrong.
